sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chatbots to autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use. Highlighted how developer tooling around memory, planning, and evaluation is becoming critical infrastructure for production AI agents.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on building reliable AI automation pipelines using open-source frameworks. Emphasized the importance of observability and debugging tools when deploying agents in production environments.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction & AI investor
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the emerging AI infrastructure stack, comparing it to the early days of cloud computing. Covered how specialized runtimes, vector databases, and orchestration layers are becoming foundational for scalable AI agent deployments.

sources.author: Matt Rickard
sources.headline: Founder @ Replicate & AI infrastructure builder
sources.post_summary: Explored the challenges of running AI agents at scale, focusing on cost optimization, latency reduction, and the need for better developer tooling around model routing and fallback strategies.

sources.author: Alex Hormozi
sources.headline: Founder @ Acquisition.com | Author of $100M Offers
sources.post_summary: Discussed how outbound automation combined with precise offer positioning can 3-5x reply rates without increasing headcount. Shared a framework for mapping ICP signals to automated sequences while maintaining personalization at scale.

sources.author: Elena Verna
sources.headline: Growth Advisor | Former CMO @ Amplitude, Webflow
sources.post_summary: Explained how GTM engineering teams are replacing traditional marketing ops by building internal tools that automate lead enrichment, scoring, and routing. Highlighted a case where a 4-person team replaced 3 full-time SDRs using custom workflows.

sources.author: Harry Stebbings
sources.headline: Founder @ 20VC | Investor
sources.post_summary: Shared insights from portfolio companies on how content strategy is now the top-of-funnel engine for outbound. Detailed a system where long-form content is repurposed into personalized cold email snippets, driving 2x higher conversion than generic sequences.

sources.author: Aakash Gupta
sources.headline: Product Growth Advisor | ex-Meta, Nike
sources.post_summary: Broke down how modern RevOps teams are using no-code + lightweight engineering to create closed-loop attribution between content engagement and pipeline. Argued that sales ops should own content distribution metrics, not just CRM hygiene.

sources.author: Sarah Nöckel
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Replicate | ex-Stripe
sources.post_summary: Posted a technical walkthrough of building an outbound automation system that syncs product usage data with email sequences. Showed how enriching leads with real-time behavioral signals increased meeting book rates by 47%.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder & CEO at Typedream | Ex-Rippling
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey building and launching Typedream as a solo founder, detailing the first 30 days of product development, user acquisition challenges, and how he iterated based on early feedback without a team.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder at Nomad List & Remote OK | Indie Maker
sources.post_summary: Posted about shipping a new micro-SaaS tool in under a week as a solo developer, including revenue numbers from the first 48 hours and lessons on validating ideas quickly without funding.

sources.author: Sara Mauskopf
sources.headline: Founder & CEO at Winnie | Previously Google & YouTube
sources.post_summary: Discussed her career pivot from big tech product roles into founding a startup, highlighting the mindset shift required, key skills transferred, and how she approached fundraising as a first-time founder.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Author of Zero to Sold | Bootstrapped Founder
sources.post_summary: Wrote about the realities of building in public as a solo founder, including transparency around revenue dips, customer churn, and the mental health aspects of running a one-person business long-term.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Software Engineer turned Founder | Ex-Meta
sources.post_summary: Shared his transition from senior engineering roles at Meta to building his own AI product solo, covering the technical decisions made in the first MVP and early user acquisition through Twitter and LinkedIn.
